# Pencil sketch

Redraws the scene as a pencil sketch on paper: contours from the geometry (depth and normals) and the image, and shading in diagonal strokes that pile up in the shadows.

<EffectDemo effect="pencil" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { pencil } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/pencil';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(pencil({ preset: 'graphite' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.lineWidth = 1.25`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                          | Default     | Range      | Description                                                             |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lineWidth`     | number                                                        | `1.25`      | 0.5 – 4 px | Width of the contour lines.                                             |
| `shading`       | number                                                        | `0.8`       | 0 – 1      | How much stroke shading fills the shadows.                              |
| `strokeSpacing` | number                                                        | `4`         | 2 – 12 px  | Distance between shading strokes.                                       |
| `imageEdges`    | number                                                        | `0.6`       | 0 – 1      | How much the image’s own edges are drawn, besides the geometry.         |
| `lead`          | hex color (theme: [`text`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles))       | `'#2b2b33'` |            | Pencil color.                                                           |
| `paper`         | hex color (theme: [`background`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#f6f2e8'` |            | Paper color.                                                            |
| `paperGrain`    | number                                                        | `0.6`       | 0 – 1      | Texture of the paper.                                                   |
| `seed`          | integer                                                       | `0`         | 0 – 9999   | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                                 |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `graphite`  | `lead: '#3a3a44'`, `shading: 0.9`                                        |
| `lineArt`   | `shading: 0`, `lineWidth: 1.5`                                           |
| `charcoal`  | `lead: '#111114'`, `lineWidth: 2.5`, `strokeSpacing: 6`, `paperGrain: 1` |
| `blueprint` | `lead: '#e8f0ff'`, `paper: '#143a6e'`, `shading: 0.4`                    |

Apply one with `pencil({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Stylization · tracked as story X8.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads depth and normals, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 8.2 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/pencil`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Crosshatch](./crosshatch) — Redraws the image in pen-and-ink hatching: darker areas get more layers of crossing lines.
- [Outline](./outline) — Draws lines where the depth or the surface direction changes, for a toon or technical-drawing look.
- [Edge detect (Sobel, Canny)](./edges) — Finds edges in the image itself (not the 3D geometry, unlike outline): Sobel gradients of brightness, optionally thinned to one-pixel lines as Canny does, over the image, on paper, or glowing on black.
